elements.name: Inspect and dismisses quick access command choices

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is selected
the quick access toolbar is above the ribbon
the user opens the quick access toolbar customization menu

the menu lists New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo, Home, Projects, Update, Select, Refine Appearance, Material Browser, Materials, Appearance Browser, Appearance Override, Adjust, Clear, Parameters, Design Doctor, Print, iProperties, Return, and Measure
each listed command displays its current checked or unchecked state
the menu offers Show Below the Ribbon
the command check states remain unchanged
the Tools ribbon and active part remain visible
